basic_info.description: A true San Francisco landmark, this timeless 5,440 sq. ft. estate offers grand spaces for modern living and entertaining. Set on nearly half an acre of lush, landscaped grounds, the home features four spacious en-suite bedrooms, two additional half baths, a formal living room, dining room, family room, breakfast room, eat-in kitchen, billiard room with bar, and a sun-filled lanai. Expansive terraces and elegant windows create a seamless flow between indoor and outdoor living, while abundant natural light highlights beautifully preserved period details throughout. Originally built in 1941 by Lakeside developer Henry Stoneson and designed by renowned architect Harold Stoner, this striking California Colonial embodies classic sophistication. Perfectly positioned on a sprawling corner lot, this iconic residence offers a rare opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco's architectural heritage elevated for today's lifestyle.
